items.title: Asian Street Fashion
items.creator: CubeCraft Games
items.description:
Welcome to Asian Street Fashion! Dive right into the city with this skin pack filled with fashionable outfits!
Get yourself ready for the day, it's time to look fabulous!

+ 10 cute HD teen skins!
+ 1 FREE skin!

By CubeCraft Games

items.title: Castles!
items.creator: Nitric Concepts
items.description:
Rule over your own city in your very own castle! Roleplay as king or queen and conquer the world!

+ Medieval themed city with multiple castles!
+ By Nitric Concepts

items.title: Thrift Store Students
items.creator: CubeCraft Games
items.description:
Thrift Store Fashion is back once again with the perfect outfits for students!
Wander through this skin pack filled with cute and fashionable skins that make you look absolutely fabulous as you play games with your friends! Adorable, trendy, and everything else you're looking for in a skin pack!

+ 8 charming skins
+ 1 FREE skin!

By CubeCraft Games

items.title: Split Armor
items.creator: Magefall
items.description:
Gear up with these split power armor designs! With bright colors underneath the armor, and a contrast of the light side and the dark side, you will be sure to stand out from the crowd!

- 8 unique skins!
- With so many colors and designs, you can pick the perfect skin that suits you!

items.title: Cute Patterns
items.creator: The Lucky Petals
items.description:
There are so many cute pattern skins to pick from! Which interesting design will you choose to become today?

- 14 cute skins
- By: The Lucky Petals

items.title: Cyber Base
items.creator: Magefall
items.description:
Cyber Base awaits! Survive and thrive in this base from the future complete with custom neon light blocks!

- Huge base!
- Custom neon light blocks!
- Swimming pool with a diving board! Basketball court!
- Farm! Stables! PvP arena!
- Perfect base to defend against mobs!
- Plenty of room to expand!

items.title: Epic Squad
items.creator: Team Visionary
items.description:
Show your powers, be creative and join the squad! Live in an epic new world among the coolest teens. Let your personality shine and brighten the city with your fancy style! Choose your favorite type and embrace a unique experience together with your friends!

+ 1 free skin 
+ 12 skins 
+ By Team Visionary

items.title: Impostors are Among Us!
items.creator: Pixelusion
items.description:
There is an imposter among us, but who is it? Choose your favorite crewmate and hide among your friends to become the imposter of your dreams!

- 12 colorful skins!
- Perfect for role-playing!
- By Pixelusion & SucreGappySan

items.title: Luxury Emojis
items.creator: Pixelusion
items.description:
Have you ever dreamed of being an emoji, but with style? Now you can.
Become your favorite expression, while being stylish.

- 11 unique and popular emojis
- Perfect for showing off to your friends!
- By Pixelusion

items.title: Funky Fruits
items.creator: Entity Builds
items.description:
Who doesn't love fruits? They're healthy, pretty, and oh so tasty! Show off your love for your favorite fruit as a fun Minecraft skin! Do you love strawberries? Are you loyal to oranges? Either way, you can show off your high-quality fruity self with the Funky Fruits skin pack!

~Easily recognizable fruits
~Fun designs sure to impress

items.title: Power Demons
items.creator: GoE-Craft
items.description:
Flex your muscles and sharpen your horns in Power Demons skins. Think up all kinds of devious tricks when you role-play with friends as strong and spirited little devils. Have fun spreading some strong mischief all over Minecraft in colorful and muscular outfits. Who can you fool and make a fool of?

+ 8 demonic forces HD skins

items.title: SCP Monsters
items.creator: GoE-Craft
items.description:
Do your best to evade all known procedures when you role-play with friends in horrific SCP Monsters skins. Frighten and scare when you invade Minecraft as a truly terrible and creepy creature. Have an evil time tormenting the city as a real paranormal sensation. Remember, laws of nature don’t apply to you, so who knows what you’ll do?

+ 8 unusual and unnatural HD skins

items.title: City Builders
items.creator: GoE-Craft
items.description:
Measure twice and build once with all the tools you need in City Builders skins. Gear up in awesome overalls and fill your pockets with measuring tape, hammer, nails, and screwdriver. Build a house, school, or office when you role-play with friends as careful craftspeople. Don’t forget to stay safe and put on your safety vest and hard hat!

+ 8 cool constructor HD skins

items.title: Crypto Armor
items.creator: GoE-Craft
items.description:
Real high-tech protection is here. Gear up in durable digital defense when you role-play with friends in cool Crypto Armor skins. Divert and deflect and decrypt using the latest technology to defend against your enemies. Keep your identity secret while you complete covert missions. Don’t forget to encrypt your code to keep it safe!

+ 8 advanced armor HD skins

items.title: Paper Parrots
items.creator: GoE-Craft
items.description:
Look perfect on a perch or flutter from tree to tree and show off your colorful feathers in Paper Parrots skins. Made from wrapping paper, cardboard, or construction paper, role-play with friends as the best imitators in the animal world. Fly high in the sky and swoop down to tell Minecraft residents that you want a cracker!

+ 8 tropical tissue HD skins

items.title: Derp Demons
items.creator: GoE-Craft
items.description:
Let your dorky demon side rule! In goofy grins and googly eyes, role-play with friends in devilish Derp Demons skins. Gear up in demonic horns and stylish red and black clothing and try not to stumble and fall too much. Be a foolish fiend when you try and fail to make mischief all around the city. Watch your drool!

+ 8 silly evil spirit HD skins

items.title: Woodland Animals
items.creator: The Lucky Petals
items.description:
Roleplay as woodland critters! These animals are so precious and look adorable. Which of these cute skins will you choose to roleplay as?

- 10 skins

items.title: Mob DJs
items.creator: BLOCKLAB Studios
items.description:
Get down and dance with these musical mobs! Our DJs are playing the latest hits for you and your friends to jam out to!

- 12 Mob DJs
- 2 free skins included
- Are you ready to PARTY?
- Published by BLOCKLAB Studios under license from LeadPro.

items.title: Forest Manor
items.creator: BTWN Creations
items.description:
Live in a manor on the edge of a forest. Take a walk on the path to enjoy access to a lake front gazebo, a private mining operation and your very own boat house.

-By BTWN

items.title: Bounty Hunter
items.creator: Shapescape
items.description:
Enter a cyberpunk universe and get ready to capture the bandits around your city! Use your speeder to chase the crime lords and take them down! Earn money by collecting bounties, doing minigames, or side quests! Good luck!

+ Cyberpunk city
+ Upgradable speeders
+ Minigames
+ Custom music!

What are you waiting for? Enter the cyberpunk city now!
